_comment: Real WebReg response captured 2026-11-15 (Spring 2027, signed in) to the one authorized live add of CSCI-103 section 29966, sent by extension 0.1.2 without WebReg's X-CSRF header. Nothing was added. Token scrubbed; no cookies or personal data. WebReg's own handler (handleAddCourseBin, site bundle) treats status 200 as added and any other status as an error; its site bundle adds 'X-CSRF: 1' to every same-origin jQuery ajax and fetch request.
